description: Needs a rent.dev account: sign in when your client offers it, or call rent_signup first. Output of a background process after a cursor, whether it still runs, and its exit code. Omit cursor to read from the start; pass the answer's cursor back unchanged to read only newer output. Cursors and process ids are valid while the sandbox runs.

sandbox_id.description: Sandbox id (`lse_…`) from rent_create_sandbox or rent_list_sandboxes. It names the sandbox for its whole life and keeps answering rent_get_sandbox, with the final state, after it ends.

wait_ms.description: Wait up to this long for new output. Default 0.

name: rent_get_process_output
title: Read process output
